title: Count the Conversions
description: A path payment sends USDC and asks the destination to receive EURC. The wallet supplies an intermediate path of XLM and BTC, so the payment crosses four assets before it lands.

content.prompt: A path payment sends USDC, the destination receives EURC, and the path is [XLM, BTC]. How many asset conversions happen along the route?

hint: The path lists only the intermediate assets, not the source or destination asset. Count the hops from the send asset through every path entry to the destination asset. Documentation: https://developers.stellar.org/docs/build/guides/transactions/path-payments
author: StellarHunts Core

testCases.title: Two conversions ignores the intermediate BTC stop
